entries.name: Juan Farinas

expected.charges: Interfering with the Selective Service System (Selective Service Act) — anti-war leafleting and protest at the Army induction center
expected.sentence:
Two years in federal prison (began serving after his appeals were exhausted in 1972); exact custody dates not documented

Verdict as recorded: Yes — convicted December 1970; affirmed by the Second Circuit (United States v. Farinas, 448 F.2d 1334, 1971); U.S. Supreme Court denied review March 1, 1972

updates.sentence: Two years imposed; began serving at Danbury March 20, 1972 and was released on parole April 16, 1973. Conviction affirmed by the Second Circuit in United States v. Farinas, 448 F.2d 1334 (1971).

entries.rationale: Original May1972 WorkersVanguard page8 explicitly dates prison admission March20. Original April23,1973 Bulletin frontpage photograph caption records physical departure Monday April16. Both originals visually checked; replace unverified-endpoints prose.

entries.name: Jogues Egan

expected.sentence:
Jailed for civil contempt in 1971

Charges as recorded: Civil contempt for refusing to testify before the Harrisburg federal grand jury investigating the Catholic antiwar movement

entries.rationale: Contemporary Intercontinental Press volume9 number5 states jailed January26 and released without bail January29 pending contempt appeal. This establishes physical custody endpoints, not only the order date. No separate arrest date inferred from contempt committal.

entries.name: John Boncore Hill

expected.charges: Murder of correction officer William Quinn during the Attica uprising
expected.sentence:
20 years to life

Verdict as recorded: Yes (1975) — conviction widely regarded as political; state account of Quinn's death repeatedly changed

updates.sentence: 20 years to life. Sentence commuted January 4, 1977; granted parole and released in March 1979. Commutation was not the physical-release date.

entries.rationale: Official New York State Archives timeline explicitly distinguishes January1977 commutation from March1979 parole and physical release. Replace unsupported1976release with monthprecision; earlier incarceration start is not newly verified.
